description: This Java class defines LoanCOBParameter, a data container for representing parameter bounds related to 'Close of Business' processing for loans, including fields for minimum and maximum loan IDs, and a method to convert to another COBParameter object.

classes.name: LoanCOBParameter
classes.description: A data class representing the parameters for loan COB processing, including min and max loan IDs and a method to convert to a COBParameter object.

methods.name: toCOBParameter
methods.description: Converts LoanCOBParameter into a COBParameter object using its minLoanId and maxLoanId.
